instruction: An underwater coral reef: branching staghorn and brain corals in pink, orange and violet, waving anemones with clownfish, schools of small fish drifting in formation, a sea turtle, swaying kelp and sea fans, light rays shafting down through blue water, rising bubble streams, a sandy floor with starfish, and a half-buried anchor.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Coral Reef Garden. An underwater coral reef: branching staghorn and brain corals in pink, orange and violet, waving anemones with clownfish, schools of small fish drifting in formation, a sea turtle, swaying kelp and sea fans, light rays shafting down through blue water, rising bubble streams, a sandy floor with starfish, and a half-buried anchor. Style: vivid underwater. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
